title: ThunderServe: High-performance and Cost-efficient LLM Serving in Cloud Environments
problem: LLM serving on heterogeneous cloud GPU clusters with diverse GPU types and limited/heterogeneous network bandwidth (PCIe/Ethernet rather than NVLink/InfiniBand) suffers poor throughput and high latency.
motivation: Commercial cloud clusters mix GPU types (A100, A6000, A40, RTX 3090Ti) and use commodity networking. Existing systems assume homogeneous GPUs and high-bandwidth interconnects, leaving performance on the table and missing the opportunity to assign compute-intensive prefill to high-FLOPS GPUs and memory-bandwidth-bound decode to high-HBM-bandwidth GPUs.
method: Two-level hierarchical scheduling: (1) Upper-level tabu search partitions GPU pool into model-serving groups, designating each group as prefill-phase or decode-phase. (2) Lower-level deduces optimal tensor/pipeline parallelism per group and orchestrates request routing via a two-stage transportation problem solved as linear programming. Phase splitting assigns prefill to high-FLOPS GPUs (e.g., A40) and decode to high-HBM-bandwidth GPUs (e.g., 3090Ti). 4-bit KV cache quantization for inter-phase transfer; dequantized before use. Lightweight rescheduling adjusts phase designation and orchestration without model reload when load changes.
key_novelty: First system integrating prefill-decode phase splitting with heterogeneous GPU assignment in cloud environments with low-bandwidth interconnects, using tabu search for upper-level partition and LP for lower-level routing.
contributions: Two-level hierarchical scheduling with tabu search (upper) and linear programming (lower)
Prefill-decode phase splitting matched to heterogeneous GPU compute vs bandwidth profiles
4-bit KV cache quantization for efficient inter-phase transfer over low-bandwidth networks
Lightweight rescheduling completing in ~13s vs ~157s for full reschedule

metrics.speedup: Up to 2.1x, avg 1.7x throughput vs SOTA; up to 2.5x, avg 1.5x latency reduction
metrics.other: Rescheduling completes in ~13s vs ~157s for full reschedule

limitations: Tabu search for upper-level partition may not converge to global optimum
4-bit KV quantization adds small accuracy loss
LP routing optimization is per-scheduling-event, may lag rapid workload shifts
